auth.label: Personal Access Token
auth.description: Softr Personal Access Token used with the Softr-Api-Key header. Generate it in the Softr dashboard under My account > API Settings: https://docs.softr.io/softr-api/api-setup-and-endpoints.

actions.name: create_record

tableId.description: The table ID that owns the record.

additionalProperties.description: A value accepted by the configured Softr field type.

fields.description: Record values keyed by Softr field ID or field name.

fields.description: Record values keyed by Softr field ID or field name.

records.description: The records returned in this page.

limit.description: The maximum number of records returned in this page.

total.description: The total number of matching records.

actions.name: search_records

upperBound.description: The upper bound for a between condition.

items.description: A nested Softr record filter condition.

conditions.description: Nested conditions used by AND or OR operators.

filter.description: The filter applied to the search.

sortingField.description: The field ID used for sorting.
